### VAL-OPS-003: PaginationMismatchError is Schema.TaggedError with requested, received, collection; never throw new Error; never a soft-404 success
### VAL-OPS-004: Soft-404 policy matrix for every collection
Expected 404 recovery is collection-scoped. Writes are never soft-success. Sibling/unrelated 404s are never recovered. Abort is never converted into soft-404 (see VAL-OPS-008). Pass only if every row holds.
### VAL-OPS-005: Recovery matches tagged NotFoundError / endpoint-scoped helpers; unexpected HTTP stays tagged client errors
### VAL-OPS-008: HevyExecutionOptions identity, omitted when absent, inputs immutable, abort ≠ soft-404, sequential/concurrent request-local, options forwarded to every composite page
When `options` is passed to `effect`, the adapter/client call receives the same object identity (`signal`, `deadline`, `timeoutMs`). When `effect(input)` is called without options, the underlying Effect client method is invoked with arity 1 (no `undefined` options argument). Success and failure paths leave caller `input` and `options` structurally equal to a pre-call snapshot; `options.signal` identity is unchanged. An already-aborted or then-aborted signal fails with the abort error (or tagged cancel), not `not_found` / `end_of_list`, including abort during `search` / `listAll` / `trainingSummary` page N (fails the program, not a successful partial catalog — later-page **404** remains end-of-scan per VAL-OPS-004). Two sequential `effect()` calls on one instance do not leak soft-404 flags or items. Two concurrent `effect()` programs on one instance resolve independently. `trainingSummary`, `routines.search`, `templates.listAll`, and `folders.listAll` forward the same `HevyExecutionOptions` to every page request. One `HevyOperations` instance can run concurrent `effect()` programs for different domains without shared mutable request state leaking.
### VAL-OPS-009: Paginated list normalize for workouts.list, routines.list, bodyMeasurements.list, and workouts.events
Given a 200 page, each of `workouts.list`, `routines.list`, `bodyMeasurements.list`, and `workouts.events` succeeds with the requested `page`, mapped `pageCount` from `page_count`, and collection items (`workouts`/`routines`/`body_measurements`/`events` → `items` or `events`). Omitted items field → `[]` without `expected404Outcome`. Empty 200 (`items: []` with `page_count` present) is not `end_of_list`. Omitted `page_count` → `pageCount: undefined` (does not invent a count). Omitted `response.page` → requested page. Page mismatch uses VAL-OPS-003. Fail on field rename, dropped `pageCount`, or treating empty 200 as soft-404.
### VAL-OPS-010: workouts.get: entity envelope; empty body → { workout: null } without soft-404; member 404 → not_found; collection-path 404 fails
`getWorkout` returning `{ id: "w1" }` yields `{ workout: { id: "w1" } }` and descriptor `{ id: "workouts.get", safety: "read" }`. An undefined/empty workout response yields `{ workout: null }` with no `expected404Outcome`. Member GET 404 is VAL-OPS-004 `not_found`. GET 404 on `/v1/workouts` (no id) fails. Fail if empty body is flagged `not_found` or collection-path 404 is recovered.
### VAL-OPS-014: workouts.events: forwards page/pageSize/since; page>1 404 → end_of_list; page 1 404 fails; mismatch uses VAL-OPS-003
`workouts.events.effect({ page, pageSize, since })` calls Effect `getWorkoutEvents` with those params and returns `{ events, page, pageCount, since }`. Envelope normalize follows VAL-OPS-009. Soft-404 follows VAL-OPS-004. Fail if `since` is dropped, events are renamed without mapping, or page mismatch is a generic `Error`.
### VAL-OPS-016: routines.get: nested routine entity (not envelope); empty → { routine: null } without soft-404; member 404 → not_found; collection-path 404 fails
`{ routine: { id: "r1", title: "Push", exercises: [] } }` yields that routine object (not the outer envelope) and descriptor `{ id: "routines.get", safety: "read" }`. `{}` yields `{ routine: null }` with no `expected404Outcome`. Member/collection 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if get-by-id recovers `/v1/routines` 404 as `not_found`.
Effect `getExerciseTemplate(id)` success maps to `{ exerciseTemplate, exerciseTemplateId }` (or equivalent domain fields). Descriptor id `templates.get`, safety `read`. Member/collection 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if collection or unrelated 404 is recovered as `not_found`.
`templates.listAll.effect()` walks `/v1/exercise_templates` with pageSize 100 using `Stream.paginate`, concatenating `exercise_templates` until empty page or pageCount boundary. Later-page / first-page 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if it uses `while (true)`, `fetchAllPages`, or Promise loops, or if page 1 404 returns `[]` as success.
Effect `getRoutineFolder(folderId)` maps to `{ routineFolder, folderId }`, descriptor `folders.get` / `read`. Member vs collection 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if `/v1/routine_folders` 404 is recovered as `not_found`.
`folders.listAll.effect()` walks `/v1/routine_folders` with pageSize 10 using `Stream.paginate`, concatenating `routine_folders`. Later-page / first-page 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail on `while (true)` or core `fetchAllPages`.
Effect `getBodyMeasurement(date)` maps to `{ bodyMeasurement, date }`. Member vs collection 404 follow VAL-OPS-004. Fail if collection-path 404 is recovered.
- Later-page 404 ends that loader with items so far; page 1 404 fails that loader and thus the composite (VAL-OPS-004).
### VAL-OPS-038: Unit tests: in-memory Effect.succeed / Effect.fail (or mocked fetch); no live Hevy; no HEVY_API_KEY; no Git
CLI command handlers forward abort/deadline execution options into `operation.effect` (one collapse at the handler). Fail if a command invokes operations without the execution bag, or if abort/deadline is applied only to a leftover Promise `HevyClient` call. Do not re-test the HTTP interpreter (VAL-CLIENT-014) or domain catch (VAL-OPS-008).
